transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Root launch model is intent configured when configured.model is set. Response, settings, and reroute model ids are intent observed.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: displayName is added only when the optional modelDisplayName callback returns a name. modelCatalogBatch later corrects display names and does not replay other families.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: A spawnAgent collaboration item with a model id emits intent configured on the child actor.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: model/rerouted also retracts context for that actor.

applicability.notes: The pipeline also has a model normalizer. This record traces the monitor batch, which is the semantic monitor write. Per-child model requires a child thread or a spawn item, matching the declaration. These monitor files are in the set GV2 reported as different from shipped 0.3.3; the trace is still 748d015 only. The contract row is not written by the adapter. Mapping into MonitorAgentRow is pending and owned by GV-AUDIT2. This trace is Puppeteer 748d015a7e393112e0a91dad80111fdf5abe6583 only. It is newer than shipped Vibefield 0.3.3 and does not describe that install. Package comparison was not re-run. Declaration supported from codex-thread-response-settings-and-reroute. declaration only; supported does not guarantee availability/value; degraded is not unreachable A missing or unsupported adapter signal does not rule out the row value from host, runtime, or another producer. Upstream states: adapter.codex.upstream.model.configured="configured" (root launch model and spawnAgent model); adapter.codex.upstream.model.observed="observed" (thread response, settings, reroute); adapter.codex.upstream.model.display.omitted="displayName omitted" (callback missing or returns nothing) Continuation: MonitorService.consume then core reduce and project, then deriveAgentRow. Vibefield AgentView and window-rows are not traced.
